description: Renovate updates package-lock.json with npm 11, the npm of the Node 24 image the Dockerfile builds with. Left to itself it takes the newest npm, and npm 12's default allow-remote=none refuses @tailwindcss/oxide-wasm32-wasi's tarball (EALLOWREMOTE), so every lockfile update failed. Raise this with the Dockerfile's Node.

packageRules.description: TypeScript stays below 7: typescript-eslint, which eslint-config-next brings in, refuses TypeScript 7 ("typescript-eslint does not support TS 7.0"), so the lint check fails (#17). Lift this when a typescript-eslint release supports it.
